title: Von der Becke family arms
source: Max von Spießen, Wappenbuch des Westfälischen Adels, vol. 2, plate 19
explanation: The two horns shown on the shield are repeated in the crest above its helm. This is a documented early-twentieth-century depiction of a German family achievement, not a modern grant of arms.
alt: German armorial illustration with a blue shield displaying two gold horns and a helmet topped by two similarly colored horns, surrounded by blue and gold mantling.
rightsNote: Published 1901–1903; author died in 1918. Commons identifies the image as public domain.
changes: Unaltered Commons file; browser-scaled for responsive layout

title: Royal crest of Aragon
source: Modern vector emblazonment based on the historical Aragonese royal crest
explanation: A winged dragon forms the crest. Its presence makes an immediate counterexample to treating the Iberian traditions as categorically crestless. The drawing is modern; it is not a medieval photograph.
alt: Heraldic vector illustration of the Aragonese royal crest, depicting a stylized winged dragon above a helmet.
rightsNote: Artwork released by Heralder under CC BY-SA 3.0; illustrated heraldic use is distinct from entitlement.
changes: Unaltered Commons file; browser-scaled for responsive layout

title: Majorcan variant of the Aragonese crest
source: Vector heraldic representation derived from a representation of the historic crest in Majorca
explanation: A second rendering helps distinguish the identifying motif from an individual artist's treatment. Comparing it with the other Aragonese image teaches a different problem from identifying the medieval physical artifact.
alt: Vector rendition of a winged golden-dragon royal crest of Aragon mounted above a heraldic helmet.
rightsNote: Commons permits reuse under CC BY-SA 3.0 (also offers older licence versions).
file: Royal Crest of Aragon-Variant used in Majorca.svg

title: Historic royal achievement of Scotland
source: Modern vector rendering, with blazon reference to J. H. and R. V. Pinches, The Royal Heraldry of England
visualKind: Modern rendering of a historic royal achievement
explanation: The shield, crowned helm, royal crest, heraldic supporters, orders, banners, compartment and motto make distinct visual statements within one assembled achievement. Copyright reuse does not convey authority to bear Scottish royal arms.
alt: Elaborate Scottish royal coat of arms with central lion shield, crowned helm and lion crest, two chained unicorn supporters holding banners, and an order collar.
rightsNote: The Commons file warns that Scottish law separately regulates armorial use; publication as an attributed educational example does not claim entitlement.
file: Royal Coat of Arms of the Kingdom of Scotland.svg
changes: Unaltered Commons file; browser-scaled for responsive layout

title: Crest element from a Scottish crest-badge diagram
artist: Celtus; file later optimized by Smasongarrison
source: Original diagram of one component of the Scottish crest badge
explanation: This is the isolated crest element, not a full clan badge and not a legal identification of any particular clan member. A crest badge requires the surrounding context that communicates the wearer's relationship to the chief.
alt: Isolated heraldic crest emblem used in a teaching diagram explaining Scottish crest badges.
rightsNote: Component file by Celtus, with later optimization; attribution to original creator and linked file history retained.
changes: Unaltered Commons file; browser-scaled for responsive layout

title: Royal banner of Scottish arms
artist: Eyrian (vector drawing, derived from an earlier lion-rampant image)
source: Modern vector representation of the banner of the royal arms
visualKind: Modern vector illustration of a royal banner
explanation: The lion and tressure occupy the cloth without a shield outline. The banner represents the royal arms; it is not a general family flag or an open emblem for unrestricted armorial use.
alt: Horizontal yellow Scottish royal banner with a red lion rampant enclosed in a red double tressure decorated with fleurs-de-lis.
rightsNote: Commons specifically notes legal restrictions on unauthorized use of the royal arms despite the copyright licence.
changes: Unaltered Commons file; browser-scaled for responsive layout

title: Canadian royal arms with the Canadian Crown
source: Own-work vector emblazonment of the 2023 Canadian Crown variant
explanation: A complete public achievement offers a contrast with the individual components below. This is a 2023 rendering; do not assume every historical Canadian achievement or older crown uses the same version.
alt: Full Canadian royal coat of arms with a central shield of British and Canadian charges, crowned crest, lion and unicorn supporters, order collar, and motto below.
rightsNote: Commons explicitly distinguishes copyright in the SVG from separately restricted use of official heraldic signs.

alt: Illustration of a golden lion and a white unicorn holding heraldic flags, shown independently of the central Canadian shield.

title: Lesser-form Canadian royal arms
